samples_reviewed.question_text: The dot is at 244 and it moves backward 150 numbers. Starting from 244, just count back 150 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
The total is 30 and one part is 29. What is the other part?
The total is 71 and one part is 60. What is the other part?
Noel solved: "120 − 81 = ___". Noel says the missing number is 39. Is Noel correct?
The dot is at 591 and it moves backward 487 numbers. Starting from 591, just count back 487 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?
Dante solved: "823 − 659 = ___". Dante says the missing number is 164. Is Dante correct?
There are 765 baskets on the table. Moses takes away 110 baskets. How many baskets are left on the table?
Jose solved: "270 − 247 = ___". Jose says the missing number is 23. Is Jose correct?
The dot is at 1 and it moves backward 1 number. Starting from 1, just count back 1 number. Which number will the dot land on?
Carlo solved: "416 − 0 = ___". Carlo says the missing number is 416. Is Carlo correct?
The dot is at 28 and it moves backward 15 numbers. Starting from 28, just count back 15 numbers. Which number will the dot land on?

competency_fulfillment.rationale: The core of the set is genuine three-digit subtraction - 510 less 382, 930 less 408, 823 less 659, 591 less 487 - and each difference I checked is correct, so the operation the competency names is being practised properly at its top end.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: Regrouping-required cases such as 300 less 204 and 270 less 247 appear beside clean ones such as 765 less 110, so both branches of the with-and-without clause are represented in the sample set.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: One option list offers -1 as a choice. Negative numbers are not part of the Grade 2 number system and must not be placed in front of a pupil at this stage; here the item counts a dot backwards from 1 and the surrounding distractors make the negative look like a live candidate. The same family also tells the child to 'count back 487 numbers', an instruction no second grader can act on.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Horizontal equations, a part-and-whole phrasing, a backwards-moving dot, a baskets story and peer-error checks are all sampled, so the presentation spread here is wider than in the neighbouring subtraction nodes.

competency_alignment.rationale: Several rungs sit far below what the under-1000 band implies: 'What is 11 − 0?' needs no computation, a part-whole item gives a total of 30 against a part of 29, and a dot moves back one place from 1. These vary triviality rather than building three-digit regrouping.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: The ceiling is respected, with 930 the largest minuend, but roughly a third of the samples work below 100, so the three-digit range the competency defines is under-represented relative to how much of the sample set it should own.
